name: TwitterAPI.io New-Account Credits
free_limit: Up to $1 (100,000 API credits) as a one-time new-account sign-up allowance after an automated bot check; credits expire 31 days after issuance.
watch_out: Not an ongoing free tier or recurring monthly credit. One offer per person/network; another signup on the same IP within 30 days may receive only $0.10. A valid sign-up bonus may be denied by anti-abuse checks. Subsequent API usage requires paid top-ups or subscriptions, with usage-based credit consumption and minimum request charges. Commercial use and X content/data licensing restrictions must be verified for the specific use case.
